text.description_html:
Emtek B120105-SS, 5 Foot Single Door Stainless Steel Barn Door Kit

This is a Top Mount Modern Rectangular Barn Door Kit. It features a solid wheel design with a Flat Fastener Style. This 5 Foot Stainless Steel Barn Door Kit comes with everything you need to install a sliding door up to 28 inches in width. It comes packaged with a 60-inch track that is suitable for hanging a single door. It has anti-jump design that will keep the sliding door from easily falling off the track.

Features of the Sliding Barn Door Installation Kit:

  • Comes with all necessary hardware to install wood barn door.
  • All stainless steel construction.
  • Anti-jump Mechanism .
  • Comes with a Floor Guide.
  • The wall or structure that your system will be mounted on must be designed to support a maximum door weight of 400 lbs.

Specifications of the 60 Inch Stainless Steel Barn Door Kit:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Track: 60" (5 feet)
  • For door openings from 24" to 28".
  • Emtek B120105 Installation Guide (PDF)
  • Emtek B120105 Specifications Diagram (PDF)

Package Includes:

  • 1 Stainless Steel 60" Track
  • 2 Hangers
  • 2 Stainless Steel Door Stops
  • 1 Floor Mounted Door Guide
  • Track Fasteners
  • Drywall Anti-crush spacers
  • All necessary installation hardware.

In case of a doorway larger than 28", longer length tracks up to 16 feet are available. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Sold as a set for one door.
